title: Python 3 integer literal lexer
skill: Language lexical grammar vs runtime parsing (int(s, 0) is not the grammar)
traps: int(s, 0) accepts whitespace, signs and non-ASCII digits, the grammar does not
an underscore may follow the base prefix ('0x_f')
no trailing, leading or doubled underscores
non-ASCII digits like '١' or '１' are not valid literals
case of the prefix letter does not matter
